title: Beautiful
text: Beautiful. This is a beautiful crystal Ornament. My personal idea is that it's little too heavy on a tree so I bought a stand To hang it from and put on my fire place. It has very nice cuts in the crystal that's sparkle when sunlight or room light hits it.
